desktop_notifications_enable_hint: Native Windows notifications for new messages and calls.
desktop_notifications_sound_hint: Play a sound with notifications and in-app alerts.
desktop_notifications_preview_hint: Show message text inside notifications. Disable to hide content.
desktop_notifications_hidden_hint: Show system notifications only when the app is unfocused, minimized or hidden.
desktop_close_to_tray_hint: Keep running in the system tray when the window is closed.
desktop_tray_icon_hint: Show the application icon in the system tray.
desktop_auto_start_hint: Launch the client automatically after signing in to Windows.
desktop_start_minimized_hint: Open the app in the tray instead of showing the window on launch.
desktop_interface_language_hint: Changes the language of the whole client and reloads the window.
desktop_e2e_lib_missing: E2E libraries (libsignal) are missing in src/renderer/static/js/libsignal
desktop_clear_cache_hint: On graceful exit the cache is removed immediately; after a crash or power loss it is purged on the next start.
desktop_auto_update_hint: Poll the release feed every 15 minutes and on startup.
